whole_source_finding: The complete D05 penlight proposition requires one clinician to own two distinct hands, a beam to one patient eye, and the other hand at the brow. EYE_EXAM realizes all those clauses; changing the lamp-preparation action to patient examination increases face/hand/eye endpoint density and reduces the clean two-worker preparation relationship. It is compatible medical meaning but less useful for this chosen photograph. No D05 relation remains in the final.

The whole source requires a vast circular device, small workbench and dark hall. A surgical lamp and operating table are not those owner/scale/place properties. Substituting their names would erase its distinguishing scale relation; adopting the entire dark-hall setting would make a different world premise at creativity 1, with no concrete benefit to the selected clinical teamwork.

The whole four-component source is a cup reaching its matching saucer, fingers on its handle, opposite hand clear, and reception-room table between upholstered seats. Neither a light handle nor an operating table is a cup/saucer owner. No reception scene or cup is established and the relation contributes no distinct clinically coherent local change to the selected lamp action.

The complete A01 meaning is one articulated surgical lamp above one operating table with a separate metal instrument trolley beside it. The baseline already has the first two owners; LAMP_TROLLEY adds the separate readable trolley. This local setting refinement reinforces the operating-room use without adding another action. Selected as H-F2 source-informed inspiration only; the full arrangement is retained, not native qualification.

The source requires a near-ninety-degree key, face-center division, bright versus modeled shadow halves, retained eye/cheek/jaw structure, and the adult-character prerequisite. The frozen source provides no declared adulthood witness; source effect/admission metadata is not permission to invent one. Its portrait split would additionally compete with the face-guidance view. Not selected.

The full bundle requires a helper hand between the existing lamp and recipient eyes, a localized hand-cast eye shadow and the connected trio together. SHIELD realizes these three clauses. It supplies a concrete reason for mutual care, but the hand/eye shadow competes with reference-face readability and adds another raised arm near the handle. The simpler light-position judgment remains clearer; no shielding compound is retained.

F12 requires two people joined at their hands, warm bedside-lamp illumination on that contact, and neutral ceiling light retaining patient face and medical equipment. BEDSIDE realizes the complete two-source lighting and hand-contact arrangement. It supplies human contact but shifts the action and place from working preparation to bedside care, with more important endpoints behind a curtain. Not preferred; no joined-hand or patient-light claim is retained.

D18 requires the wearer both arms inside long gown sleeves, another staff member behind holding rear ties, and helper hands separate from the gown front. GOWN realizes the whole proposition rather than borrowing a single sleeve. It is a strong compatible operating-preparation alternative, but the rear tie contact and front face compete for view; the lamp version has a larger visible result on the table and a clearer cross-frame link. Not selected.

E06 requires several adult observers behind glass facing an illuminated demonstration table with a clothed adult model under opaque drape. The frozen scene supplies neither the adult-context witness nor those actual owners. It is not permissible to rename staff as observers or the empty table as a model; no whole-source adoption.

This source explicitly owns a wall lamp and its localized pool across adjacent wall and table, fading into room light. WALL_POOL keeps that apparatus distinct from the surgical light rather than relabeling its hand-held adjustment. It is a compatible local illumination addition, but introduces a third light source and second table with little benefit to the main practical action. Skipped.

A11 is a brightly lit clinical room with aligned trays, uninterrupted pale wall and one chair at a slight angle. ORDERED_ROOM realizes all properties, including the chair relation. It is compatible as a room layer but asks the viewer to notice a compositional discrepancy unrelated to the light adjustment, adding an avoidable second visual question. Skipped.

F11 explicitly occludes the near half of a bed with a partly drawn privacy curtain while patient head and seated clinician remain visible through its opening. BEDSIDE realizes that whole boundary and patient/clinician pair. It creates intimacy but the opening creates more projection competition than the open theatre preparation frame; it is an unchosen alternative, not a generic curtain cue.

A10 requires stepped concentric viewing rails descending toward one central demonstration table separate from surrounding seats. A modern operating table and overhead arms do not supply those rails or spectator architecture. Its complete institutional space would reframe the selected teamwork as a demonstration; no justified restrained local change arises.

This cosmic creation-space source requires world_parent_separation as primary context and near-contact sky/earth around a widening central interval. The frozen clinical setting supplies no such premise; open setting does not establish this prerequisite. Skipped without borrowing the word interval.

The complete everyday source is a person adjusting a shoe at a doorway with a bag or coat within departure reach and stable entrance boundary. The lamp-handle contact does not substitute for its shoe target. Those owners and departure situation add no distinct relevant clinical preparation relation; not retained.

The chair-adjustment source names two adults and a chair and requires every actor, object, garment and place outside its effects to be established before adoption. No chair or declared adult witnesses exist in the frozen scene. Adding them from this source would violate its existing-context condition. Not selected.

The visual profile spells the same lamp-helper-hand-recipient-eye-shadow connection as source 5, retaining actual owners and whole relation rather than self-shading. SHIELD is the concrete compatible alternative; reference-face visibility and additional raised-arm competition make it less useful than the chosen table-light action. The optional profile is not selected and adds no mandatory gates.

A06 requires three distinct standing clinicians at one bedside, one tablet angled to the other two, and the patient visible beside the display. ROUNDS realizes the complete count, shared-screen orientation and patient boundary. It makes teamwork explicit, but four faces plus screen and patient are a more diffuse hierarchy than the chosen two-person light-result triangle. Compatible but not preferred.

The source requires one hand gripping its own opposite wrist behind the torso, both arms continuous to the actor, and the inspection object ahead. QUIET_OBSERVER realizes this pose for the secondary clinician while retaining the central nurse action. The inspection becomes quieter but loses the table-hand cue that connects the second person to the light footprint. The original active judgment is clearer.

G19 requires distinct specimens and artifacts in separate cabinet compartments with small labels beside each. The final equipment trolley is not a specimen cabinet. No classification event belongs to the light-position judgment, and a complete cabinet layer would introduce competing small labelled objects rather than develop this action.

A050 requires tape sleeve and matching catalogue card carrying different short date labels. Neither object is a generic hospital report. Its source retains textual disagreement rather than proving deception; that separate archival proposition has no developed relation to the visible light-adjustment scene and is not used.

This milestone source requires the primary next_milestone_ambition context and distinct completed/current/next state markers without readable text. Preparation before a patient is not that desire-system prerequisite. No progress markers are introduced.

G71 requires labelled separate jars and two-pan balance together on a shop counter. An instrument trolley is not that shop-counter relation. The source would supply an apothecary setting and weighing premise rather than a local operating-room refinement, so its objects are not borrowed.

A053 requires recognizable base station graphic, distinct abrupt rectangular graphic overlapping only part of it. This is a bounded displayed-image proposition, not clinical equipment. No broadcast screen is independently present and inventing that side incident has no concrete benefit to the selected clinical action.

H06 requires a stylized artificial brain specimen in clear liquid inside a transparent sealed display vessel, with leads traversing its sealed lid port. Its complete fictional display would add a laboratory premise unrelated to light positioning. No artificial specimen, fluid or disconnected wire is borrowed as operating-room decor.

The reports source requires a seated person pointing between two separate reports with visibly different chart traces, and explicit binding of each existing owner/part to frozen evidence. No reports, seated person or grounded report-owner witnesses exist. Its chart comparison cannot be reduced to the colleague hand beside the surgical pool.

Concept object photography would center an object as the main subject. The required reference-guided central person anchors this run; treating the lamp as the primary subject would undermine that governing subject meaning. The existing room props remain supporting objects.

V40 explicitly requires a covered fictional body on a supported medical platform, its own articulated hand extending past the cover and gripping the platform edge. It mutates subject as well as pose/relationship/setting. The required central person cannot be replaced by a covered body or an invented disconnected hand; no fragment is retained.

The source requires a square-enough face inspection, soft frontal daylight and restrained surface treatment together under human/portrait context. Skin variation is already present independently, but the complete front daylight casting setup would redirect camera and illumination away from the clinical lamp action. No distinctive source compound is retained as generic face readability.

The full profile requires a visible practical, outward falloff pool, direction/color continuity onto the subject, distinct ambient zone and coherent source-owned shadows. The baseline already independently motivates two clinical lights and their pool. No distinct compatible extra realization is needed; the profile itself is not selected, and ordinary physical lighting is not claimed as native whole-profile adoption.

This source requires pale white appearance confined to the same hair contours and readable strands, with comparison against gray or tint. It conflicts with the supplied dark-hair appearance guidance and would replace a reference feature; no adoption.

The full profile requires thumb under chin, index on cheek, same-arm elbow supported on desk, and continuous hand/wrist/arm/head ownership. CHIN_OBSERVER realizes it for the secondary clinician with an adjacent desk. It adds furniture and a self-supporting contemplative pose while weakening the direct table-result interaction; the original colleague hand beside the pool is preferable.
